name: Vida AI
task: AI voice agents that answer for you
summary: Deploy autonomous frontline voice agents. Let AI answer calls, book appointments, and handle FAQs 24/7 without sounding robotic.
best_for: service businesses, agencies and MSPs that want AI phone agents to answer, qualify or schedule calls, with enough call volume to plan usage month by month and someone to set the agent up
skip_if: you want a flat price with calls included, since every minute and token is metered; you take a few calls a week and $250 a month for the platform alone outweighs them; or your call flows are too high-stakes to automate yet
honest_knock: The $250 Starter fee buys the platform and one agent, not the calls: every voice minute is $0.15, AI tokens are billed on top by model, a second agent is another $250 a month, and one-time setup fees may come in a quote. Business allowances do not roll over, and the terms rule out refunds. And the universal truth of voice AI: demo calls are rehearsed, your callers aren't, so test it on your real call types (accents, interruptions, edge requests) before betting the front desk on it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, 1 agent, no included usage: voice $0.15 a minute in 60-second increments, outbound texts $0.06, AI tokens by model
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-17 in a browser on vida.io/pricing with its FAQ and on vida.io/rate-card; the page has changed since our reading of 13 October 2026, when it published no plans and only a scoped pilot from $1,500, and the rate card says its rates took effect on 14 October 2026) Vida now publishes a monthly plan ladder. Starter is $250 a month with 1 agent and no included usage: you pay for usage as you go. Business 500 is $700 a month with 1 agent and $500 of usage included each month, Business 1k is $1,150 with $1,000 included, and Business 2k is $2,050 with $2,000 included; Vida labels these as saving $600, $1,200 and $2,400 a year. Enterprise is quoted. Usage rates are the same on Starter and Business: voice $0.15 a minute, billed in 60-second increments; outbound text messages $0.06 each, inbound free; and AI tokens billed by model per million tokens, from $0.10 input and $0.80 output for GPT-5 Nano to $20.00 input and $100.00 output for the largest models listed. Add-ons on any plan: additional agents $250 per agent a month, phone numbers $5 per number a month and Text Messaging $25 a month; premium support, advanced privacy, SOC 2 security, outbound and managed agents are quoted. The FAQ says the included usage is a dollar allowance shared across all agents that does not roll over, and usage above it is billed at the same rates. There is no plan or platform setup fee, but one-time setup fees may apply to the agents and add-ons you choose and are itemised in a quote. Downgrades generally take effect at renewal, and SMS registration may take up to two weeks. Correction to our own earlier dossier: an agency ladder of about $750 a month for 5 agents and roughly 2,500 AI voice minutes, plus platform plans from about $2,500 and the per-minute rate we derived from them, appeared nowhere on vida.io when we checked on 10 September 2026; the plans above are the first prices Vida itself has published.
